name: Infinity
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) annual report, INFINITY TRUST MORTGAGE BANK PLC statement of financial position at 31 December 2025, Naira CRON 20261118: cash and cash equivalents added from the statement of financial position (printed page 53): cash and balances with the Central Bank of Nigeria 262,824,579 plus due from banks 7,747,103,137 for 2025 and 113,036,360 plus 3,478,016,130 for 2024, which reproduce the printed cash flow closing balances 8,009,927,716 and 3,591,052,490 exactly.
note: Balance sheet checked against the accounting identity (assets = liabilities + equity). Rows computed from the period's own component rows or from the other two totals are marked derived; figures that could not be reconciled are withheld and listed in _balance_identity_withheld.json.

source_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-06: the previous total assets row held unrelated figures (8,245,924,459 for 2025) and total liabilities and total equity were blank. Replaced with the audited statement of financial position, page 53 of the report, Naira. Total liabilities plus total equity equals total assets exactly on both years. The bank does not classify its statement of financial position between current and non-current, so no current or non-current rows are written; the four split rows are absent because the issuer does not present them, not because a figure is missing. The three older columns (FY2023, FY2022, FY2021) were dropped rather than carried.
